notes.title: Demo Update #4 - Fixes Galore + Become the LIGHT
notes.content:
Hey DJs – We broke 5,500 wishlists!! Woo hoo! Thank you to everyone supporting the game as we keep refining the vibe. Today, we have a healthy patch of fixes and one key feature addition. 
Become The Light
Now, your power wires also serve as ways to transport you around the map! We will be adding this feature to all wires in the future so you can ride the wave whenever/wherever you want!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536923/34c3703c856b82a774e2daf92c8f1d34e968f2fb.gif"]
UI/UX
Easier Pitches: Fixed Vibe Node menu. Should be easier to select pitches across different aspect ratios without it auto closing. Also, don't forget that you can SHIFT + Click on nodes to set multiple pitches at once if you have the set pitch ability unlocked!

Updated Indicator icons and underlying Indicator system.
Settings/Performance:
15% Performance Gain: Improved rendering settings, added more graphics options, and made key optimizations. Much more optimization to come!!

SFX: Total Volume setting will now also impact sound from your music. 
Gameplay:
Gatherer: Fixed series of resource gatherer bugs preventing mining in certain map positions.

Merger: Set Merger to First Come First Served as Default. 

Synth Factory: Modified model.

Items: Improved state management of items after long play sessions and reduced cost of certain recipes. 

Networks: More lenient signal checks to prevent signals from not completing. 
** REMINDER: For returning players, if you run into any issues make sure to Verify Integrity of Demo Files on Steam.

notes.title: Demo Update #3 - Community Features!
notes.content:
Hey DJs—Unwise here with another update to the demo to support our participation in TinyTeams and the DebutFestival! Time to VIBE!
Community Sharing Improvements!
Upvote feature! Now you can upvote your favorite factories from the community!

Filtering + Tags! Now, you can tag your saves as either a Cover, Original, or WIP. We have also increased the amount of Creative Mode saves to share to 15. 

Featured Panel Everyday, a new set of community saves will be featured on the main page. 


So, go out there, build a vibe, share it, and have a chance for everyone who logs in to see it!

QOL:
New camera rotation feature! See the world from new angles. 

Added dedicated bug reporting feature.

Reworked and New Tutorial!

Tons of other bug fixes and UI cleanup. 


What's Next? 
We are spending the rest of August on more QOL and stability. Next up is MIDI support, controller support, and improvements/reworks to some of the core game loops for more fun, faster. Jump in, share your saves, and let's flood the world with fresh beats! Huge thanks to everyone who's played, wishlisted, and chatted in Discord already. Your participating in the Vibe helps this vibe to keep going. Much love ✌️🎶



***

For returning players, if you run into any issues make sure to Verify Integrity of Demo Files on Steam.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix #1 - July 18th
notes.content:
Thanks to all the vibers submitting bug reports! We got most of the critical ones fixed up with our first hotfix and expect another batch solved soon. 


Community Save Fixes
Sharing older saves should work consistently now.

Fixes to ensure your instrument choices are retained when other players load your creative save.

Fixes to make sure your steam name will be displayed on a save you shared.
Beat Maker and Inventory Fixes
Prevented stallouts at beat maker with crafting.

Reduced chance of error with inventory deposits at visual crafters like the beat maker. 

Will be blogging about this later as there is some interesting nuance to our systems that allow for visual crafting, per item interactability, AND inventory interactions all together. However, this flexibility led to some edge cases being missed with the new update. Let us know if you still have any issues! 
Save/load Fixes
Power Wire Loading: if you have a lot of power generators you won't see a breakdown of wire connectivity upon load. This was due to a change in the initialization order of our power system that we have fixed. 

Creative Mode Fixes: Some fixes tied to instrument choice and loading here as well.

notes.title: Demo Update - Community Sharing + Visual Crafting
notes.content:
Hey DJs—Unwise here with a big update to the Future Vibe Check alpha demo! We're thrilled to roll this out just in time for Automation Fest kicking off today (July 14th). This patch is all about making music-building more intuitive and shareable. 
1. Community Save Sharing – Share Your Vibes!
Ever built a Vibe so epic you wanted the world to hear it? Now you can! Players can upload and share up to 3 of their Creative Mode saves directly with the community. 

How it works: Head to the load menu, select your Creative Mode masterpiece, and hit "Share." Others can browse, download, and remix your setups in their own games.

Pro tip: Shared saves include all your procedural music tweaks, so the vibe travels intact. 



[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfc6G_u6BDlXi9OzdSlh4KGw2izHv0S_KUcHrC_19sizDIKJo4-pZ1Z2Vl4xhTZ5rbGF-VRAJqeLy1N5j_-5rDUyP_uSwn4HUZo_Ve8KJVnvTL9YRqt4lRS7ucuyg9z3jBVO1dLWg?key=L6DMWl05hkpaPlnZtNZf1B47"]
2. Visual Crafting Loop – See Your Music Come Alive!
Core mode just got an upgrade with a revamped crafting system. Less inventory management and more visual building —now you see your music items materialize in real-time connected to music theory. 

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcIYBME1Tw_USVSiIsXpHOqRUcnczqPuhuy95b6CdopzTpgV5DavbO_bPASonL73WUPdIkvU1-gBL_XeyroNXpAuMnCvM25nkHyY6YbICvb2wQDvi8fjBCGwgTsKnXQCmxGpTtJug?key=L6DMWl05hkpaPlnZtNZf1B47"]

Visual Crafting: Your music items morph in real-time as you progress. 

Capacity: Reworked to support slot based models for less factory jam ups. 

Time = Beats Extraction: Your new starting point! This entry-level machine provides basic music items to help get something started early. 

Note: Old Core Mode Saves will not be compatible with the latest update. 


3. Quality-of-Life Bonanza – Faster Flows!
We've packed in tons of player-requested tweaks to reduce friction. From initial feedback, we targeted UX hurdles head-on:

Hold-to-Place Belt Paths: Drag and hold for seamless conveyor chains, including T-junction splits. No more click-fest for long runs!

Mass Delete & Multiselect: Shift-click to select groups of nodes to modify their values at once. Shift+right click to mass delete. Rework entire sections in seconds.

Tooltip Cleanup: Smarter, non-obtrusive pop-ups that dock + fade intelligently.

Factory Placement Hotkeys: Quick hotkeys for your favorite machines. Get that APM up!

Quick Wire Connection Hotkeys: Shift + E to auto-wire nodes

Save Game Renaming: Finally! Customize your save names for easy organization—no more "Save_001" mysteries.


What's Next? Festival Vibes and Beyond!
This update sets the stage for Automation Fest and a few other festivals we are grateful to be part of coming up. Jump in, share your saves, and let's flood the world with fresh beats! 

Much more coming soon from QOL (blueprints), music making (Midi support), better tutorials, and refined economy balancing. 

Huge thanks to everyone who's played, wishlisted, and chatted in Discord. Your feedback fuels the fire. If you haven't yet, please drop a review for the demo! It helps a lot!

Keep those progressions progressing ✌️🎶



— Unwise & the FVC Team

notes.title: ✨ Alpha Demo Update #1 – June 2025
notes.content:
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdsM8PfN0QfFbGHxG5G8O0EO8JI0BtZqZEaBtTwAWe3G8h6TzvW2gyYFsHjIy9H1comIOReCZyj10O25v0FUEqQ4r7LZu7m4go6b2QqXtE_Ir-u0ugGs-6Ay4y_dLTaelXJ0Ss0?key=L6DMWl05hkpaPlnZtNZf1B47"]

The overall reception to our alpha demo has been awesome! We launched our first demo update today that addresses much of the initial incoming feedback. See below for more!

Obtrusive Tooltips - Fixed (mentioned by 32 players)
Pain Point: Our old tooltip system blocked the view when placing factories, especially when zoomed out. It was based on the concept of having inputs near the center of the screen, which proved to be a bad UX rule to follow for FVC. 

Fix: We moved the tooltips to join the rest of our HUD on the bottom panel and improved the layout so it never blocks the player's selection or placement process. 
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536923/d49fea6efc913607ec4e6e1450c6d2e79a1fc941.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536923/eb5e24e2ef4e7ec0fa78c224cf6308d7bcaea3da.png"][/carousel]Placement and Belts - Fixed (mentioned by 30 players)
Pain Point: Players had a tough time placing belts quickly. In addition, they had trouble seeing the path of their belts and struggled with the positioning of certain belt setups.

Fix: We reworked our placement system entirely which now supports

Click-and-hold placement with autogeneration of rectilinear paths, curving, and the ability to place anchors!

Indicators that reveal directions of belts and belt neighbors.

Introduction of T-junction belts in input and output positions.

Pipette tool to quickly place objects, hotkeys to open building categories, and drag-to-delete options.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536923/81f76d5426e94cc8ce4ce0c2b56cdb1a62c8c644.png"]
I/O Indicators - Fixed (mentioned by 24 players)
Pain Point: Players had a tough time knowing which direction would input into a factory and which one would be an output. 

Fix: We built a custom indicator shader that shows this information on placement and on hover that pulses to the tempo of your music! Now you can FLOW easily! 
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536923/0ddfa4e27a0b2ebae4e2404d4de6d25728cfd7e9.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536923/0878dab2c5f47a61f8ddbef9d2eb10a1c83243e4.png"][/carousel]Tutorialization Flow - Fixed (mentioned by 18 players)
Pain Point: Players felt that the tutorial and the tutorial screen system were excessive and constantly interrupted the player as it took up the whole screen and was unskippable. 

Fix: We adopted a model of progressive disclosure and a tutorial tab to the main character menu. Now, when a quest pops up the player can solve it but if they take longer than expected to complete a tutorial task, a tutorial button will pop up which they can choose to interact with. We have big plans to dramatically improve our tutorial in the July update. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536923/8c3e94382c1bdc7b8354cff012c408b5a43f72d8.png"]


Bugs - Mentioned by 15 players
Of course, we squashed tons of bugs like menu lock-ups, instrument switching, settings saving, and tons more! 
New Features 
We also added neat new tools to play around with in CREATIVE mode like a Modulator to control the timing of your music and a Signal Splitter to modify the patterns of different sections of your composition! Check out some of the wild community creations in our discord!
What’s cooking for the July Update 🔨
New tutorial path – Reworking the early game crafting loop and tutorial. Our immediate goal here is clarity, not reinvention. We want to shave time off the “aha, I’m making music!” moment while protecting the sandbox depth that testers already love.

More QOL – Improved icons, menus, and tooltips. In addition, we have plans for blueprints and mass selection. 

New Music Tools – Arpeggiation, reverse strumming and more! 
[hr][/hr]
Thanks for building the vibe with us. More soon! You can always access our roadmap or share feedback here. 

— Unwise & the FVC team 🎛️🎶
